focus: A scheduled data refresh had been publishing one feed while leaving a file derived from it behind, which made an internal verification run fail even though nothing had changed. Both the gap and the blind spot in the check that should have caught it are fixed, and a readiness indicator now describes the bar it actually measures instead of implying an easier one.
nextStep: Let real reader traffic accumulate without lowering the five-page privacy threshold, while giving each future Desk edition its own deterministic visual-integrity receipt and recent-art diversity check.

decisions.note: Expose a small deterministic mobile cohort and re-check close mix.
Refresh RUM UX ingestion before treating zero or low conversion as visitor behaviour.
Flip strict only after field p75 is sufficient and healthy.
Route top themes into feedback decision board lanes.
